newsitem.title: USA: McGraw-Hill says in lease pact.
newsitem.headline: McGraw-Hill says in lease pact.

text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc said Monday that it reached an agreement in principle to lease about seven floors of 2 Penn Plaza at 7th Avenue in Manhattan, totaling about 400,000 square feet, where a number of the corporation's business units now located elsewhere in Manhattan will be consolidated.
These real estate projects will entail capital expenditures for the build-out of the new space of up to $150 million, primarily in 1998 and 1999, McGraw Hill said.
A one-time non-cash charge on certain real estate write-offs related to the consolidation of offices is expected to be taken in the third quarter, McGraw-Hill said.
That charge is expected to be largely offset by an unrelated after-tax gain from the sale of Datapro Information Services and Northern Business Information units to Gartner Group, the company said.

The one-time charge expected to be recorded in the third quarter is related primarily to writedowns on leasehold improvements for office space due to early surrender of the space to be vacated at 1221 Avenue of the Americas by McGraw-Hill Cos, and a writedown of a company-owned building, which the corporation said it intends to sell as part of the consolidation of offices.
